target.note: The appx install location is read-only at runtime. Nothing writes beside these files; any derived or cached data goes to ApplicationData.Current.LocalFolder.

conventions.handedness: left-handed, Y up, +Z forward; plane Y=0; mesh origin = simulated entity position
conventions.units: world units 1:1, never scaled at draw time
conventions.shading: flat — face-split vertices, baked per-face normals
conventions.vertexLayout: position float3 (12) + normal float3 (12) + tangent float4 (16) + colour uint32 (4) + texcoord float2 (8)

vertexColorConvention.R: team selector. 0 = hull palette. 255 = the owning player's TEAM colour. Values between are reserved and unused in the MVP.
vertexColorConvention.G: hull tone index, quantised: 0 = HULL.DEEP, 128 = HULL.BASE, 255 = HULL.EDGE.

reserved._note: echoed. The hull palette must not collide with either.

light._decision: MINE. The design states no light rig; the plates need one and it has to be stated or the plates are not reproducible.

key.note: high, front-left. Pitched steeply so the plan view at tactical zoom is lit, which is where identification happens.

fill.note: weak underside fill so a hull's keel does not go to pure backdrop at the combat view.

ambient.note: cool ambient, multiplied by albedo — never added flat, so it cannot lift the backdrop.

material._note: One CMO material per mesh, identical values for every mesh. CMO's material block carries ambient/diffuse/specular/emissive/power plus eight texture slots; every texture slot is empty.
material.name: OC_Hull
material.note: diffuse is white because the albedo arrives entirely through the vertex colour channel. A reader that ignores vertex colour will render every hull white, which is the intended loud failure.

landmarkTests.assert: the single vertex of maximum Z is the nose, at x ~ 0, z = +45
landmarkTests.why: catches a Z flip and an X skew

landmarkTests.assert: the 4-unit slice at minimum Z is ~30 units tall in Y (the solid command block plus bridge); the 4-unit slice at maximum Z is ~5 units tall (flat lattice booms)
landmarkTests.why: catches a Z flip on an asymmetric module. Compare Y, not X width: the lattice frame is WIDER than the command block, so an X comparison inverts.

landmarkTests.assert: the maximum-Y vertex is the top hatch over the main drum, at negative X
landmarkTests.why: catches an X mirror. Do NOT compare max|X| at each side: the smaller stack sits further out than the larger drum is wide.

landmarkTests.assert: extents are exactly 220 x 54 x 220 and the maximum-Y feature is central (within 46 units of the axis) - the hub tower
landmarkTests.why: catches any scale factor and a Y flip

meshes.name: Scout
meshes.note: small hull — blunt wide wedge, eight-point angular plan at 1.11:1. Five-section chined hull, two recessed drive nacelles, dorsal sensor blister. The Miner is a Scout with a mining laser in its one slot.

meshes.name: Frigate
meshes.note: medium hull — long pointed spine, thirteen-point plan at 2.14:1 with a hard outrigger step. Five-section chined hull, two closed outrigger blisters, aft drive block. The Fighter is a Frigate with two mass drivers.

meshes.name: ModuleFrame
meshes.note: empty base-module frame — octagonal beamed ring, four corner nodes, inner cross-bracing. One slot, no drive, never moves.

meshes.name: ModuleShipyardL1
meshes.note: shipyard L1 — open lattice spine: keel boom, two converging outer booms, four transverse frames, three N-truss bays, two gantry posts, command block with bridge and side pods aft. Members 3–5 units on 18-unit bays: the voids are the shape.

meshes.name: ModuleShipyardL2
meshes.note: shipyard L2 — the same lattice with a fourth bay and a third gantry post, plus a second stacked block and a mast on the command mass.

meshes.name: ModuleOreProcessorL1
meshes.note: ore processor L1 — one closed 16-sided drum, top hatch, three intake pods. Solid mass: the type cue against the shipyard truss.

meshes.name: ModuleOreProcessorL2
meshes.note: ore processor L2 — main drum plus a second stack joined by a transfer trunk, two intakes. Two masses: the count step.

meshes.name: Station
meshes.note: one per player, fixed, never moves. Chamfered plus-shaped plate, eight-sided hub tower, two point-defence mounts on the E/W arms, four arm-end docking nodes.
